title: Lenia predator-prey: a specialist predator replicator (R+, building only from prey matter) overexploits and dies within ~100 t in a 160^2 arena but persists through repeated prey-predator oscillations for 710-940 t at 256^2 and for the whole run (>1200 t) at 320^2 (2 seeds each); as an omnivore it suppresses the prey in proportion to its predation rate while both persist
summary: world.py extends eco-lenia2 (20261025T2214-c26-eco-lenia2-claim): PRED=1 makes species B (R+) a specialist predator that builds matter only from A's (MIRd+) matter within a Gaussian neighbourhood (sigma PSIG=8, mass-conserving transfer, yield 1, B decay 0.002), is not excluded by A, and is planted onto the A colony at t=200 (T_INTRO; it starves if planted away from prey). A still builds only from food. Arena size is the only change across rows (DOMAIN, same parameters, seeds 1 and 2; cells counted by runle.py every 10 t). 160^2: B blooms to 14-27 cells, eats A from ~30 down to 4-7, and is extinct at t=280-300; A then recovers to 33-36. 256^2: B persists to t=910-1140 through 2-3 waves (prey 12-81 cells), then dies and A saturates at 72-81. 320^2: B is still alive at t=1400 on both seeds (2-39 cells, prey oscillating 43-110). PRED=2 makes B an omnivore that feeds first on nearby A matter (at most PRATE of it per unit time) and then on food: at t=600 A has 31-34 cells with competition only, 21-22 with PRATE 0.2 and 14-16 with PRATE 1.0 (seeds 1-2) while B stays at 42-49; both persist.

finding.operator: predation (matter transfer from prey to predator) between two Lenia replicator species
finding.control: arena size 160/256/320 at fixed parameters (2 seeds each); omnivore predation rate 0 / 0.2 / 1.0 (2 seeds); prey-only arm (p.txt: predator planted away from prey starves at once)
finding.result: specialist predator: last alive t=280/300 (160^2), 910/1140 (256^2), >=1400 censored (320^2); omnivore: prey cells at t=600 31-34 / 21-22 / 14-16 for PRATE 0 / 0.2 / 1.0

limits: Two seeds per size and one parameter set; 320^2 runs are censored at t=1400. Predation is a coded matter transfer and the predator is planted at t=200 onto the prey colony. Prey founders planted. I did not track lineages here (both species visibly multiply; D for MIRd+ is in the parent claim). Not yet a law: three sizes, no fitted scaling.
